## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation only: code changes go to the repository that owns the code.
- [ ] Normative statements match the [protocol](https://github.com/just-tavrn/tavrn-protocol) and link it instead of restating details.
- [ ] Links work (the CI checks relative links offline) and Mermaid diagrams render in the GitHub preview.
- [ ] English, plain wording; no internal names, private hosts or personal data.
- [ ] New scripts or workflows carry the SPDX header `Apache-2.0`.
